title: Make compiled programs and density grids read-only externally
description:
## Summary
Implement handoff A1 so compiled SDF programs and sampled density grids expose read-only native views to ordinary consumers while retaining producer-owned mutable handles internally.

## User Mandate
> implement the next set of tasks in the next wave of the larger tasklist (with the outside audit as the primary reference for upcoming sprint tasks)

STRICT. Binding constraints: use the 2026-09-05 post-PR1 outside handoff as the primary sprint reference; implement the next dependency-ready wave; preserve native ownership and disposal semantics; keep the change small and evidence-backed; do not introduce managed copies or a competing snapshot/generation architecture.

## Scope
- Change `SdfProgram.Operations` to `NativeArray<SdfOperation>.ReadOnly`.
- Change `DensityGrid.Samples` to `NativeArray<float>.ReadOnly`.
- Retain private native buffers and internal producer access for jobs and disposal.
- Update only the direct runtime consumers required by the type boundary.
- Preserve evaluator behavior, output data, and exactly-once disposal.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Ordinary consumers cannot receive mutable native handles from `SdfProgram` or `DensityGrid`.
- Burst sampling and active-cell consumers still compile and run using read-only operation/sample views.
- Generated output is unchanged.
- No managed copies or new generic ownership abstraction are introduced.
- Focused build and Unity runtime validation pass.

## Validation
Pending focused build, Unity runtime tests, console inspection, and diff review.

## Findings
The outside audit identifies A1 as the next concrete ownership slice after the measured B0 wave. Existing public properties returned mutable `NativeArray<T>` handles.

## Blockers
None known.

## Next Step
Run Unity runtime validation, inspect the console, and record evidence before closing the slice.

comments.body:
## Implementation Evidence
Implemented A1 in the owning runtime types:
- `SdfProgram` now stores its native operation buffer privately and exposes only `NativeArray<SdfOperation>.ReadOnly` publicly; internal producer access remains available for evaluator/job ownership and disposal.
- `DensityGrid` now exposes only `NativeArray<float>.ReadOnly` publicly; active-cell construction uses an internal mutable handle while the grid retains disposal ownership.
- `SdfSamplingJob` and `PartSdfDistanceJob` consume read-only operation views. No managed copies, IR, or new ownership abstraction were introduced.

## Validation Evidence
- `dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime.csproj --no-restore`: passed, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- Unity 6000.5.9f1 PlayMode assembly `ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime`: 464/464 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped.
- Unity console after the run: no product errors or warnings; only test-result save and post-build cleanup logs.
- Editor diagnostics: no errors in all four changed runtime files.
- `git diff --check`: passed. Existing unrelated worktree changes were preserved.

## Findings
The outside handoff A1 requirement was a real API ownership gap: both public properties previously returned mutable native handles. The read-only view preserves direct Burst/job reads and exactly-once owner disposal without changing generated output.

## Residual Risk
The compile-level boundary is validated by the runtime build and source API shape; no separate negative compilation fixture was added because attempting to mutate a read-only view would intentionally make the test assembly uncompilable. The next handoff-ready slice is A2 generated individual-part correspondence, followed by B1 canonical snapshot/revision authority as dependencies permit.
